scope_limits: Reviewed every sentence's cited IDs against this date's feed (title, src, published_at, cat) and every number against this date's card via my own scripts (age limits by category checked programmatically; citation counts <=2). Headlines only; article bodies not available, so claims at the edge of a headline (e.g. causal glosses on CD Projekt/Sony moves, interpretive opinions about positioning) are judged as editorial inference and left as hedged. Day-granular 08:00 stamps for Jan 31 items (Boeing-Qatar, Sony-Bungie, FTX, Moderna approval, UN session, Diem sale) were judged to describe pre-cutoff US-day events; residual uncertainty remains for same-day timing. No other date's materials or web were used.
